question: What is the relative difference in percentage points of saving note redemption rate out of the average amount outstanding for the 1980 and 1981 calendar years, rounded to the nearest hundredth places?
raw_response:
The redemption rate for 1980 = 71/326 = 21.78%, for 1981 = 51/284.5 = 17.93%. The relative difference in percentage points is 21.78 − 17.93 = 3.85 pp.

This uses the average amount outstanding = (beginning-of-year + end-of-year)/2 for each calendar year, which is the standard "average amount outstanding" interpretation. The redemption rate is total redemptions ÷ average outstanding.

<FINAL_ANSWER>3.85</FINAL_ANSWER>
